title: 2 Dream Matches Added To AEW All Out 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
1 hours ago
A major AEW World Championship match is officially set for All Out 2026, with Jon Moxley stepping up to challenge the newly crowned champion, Will Ospreay.
This week’s episode of AEW Dynamite closed with Moxley and the Death Riders coming to Ospreay’s aid after Gabe Kidd attempted to attack the AEW World Champion with a steel chair. Following the confrontation, Moxley picked Ospreay up and handed him the championship belt.
Moments later, AEW confirmed the meaning behind the gesture when a graphic appeared announcing Moxley vs. Ospreay for the AEW World Championship at All Out 2026.
The bout will mark Ospreay’s first defense of the AEW World Championship since capturing the title from Kenny Omega in the main event of AEW All In 2026.

The AEW World Tag Team Championships will also be defended in a massive three-way showdown at All Out 2026.
During Wednesday night’s episode of AEW Dynamite, Adam Copeland revealed that he and Christian Cage will put their titles on the line against both FTR and The Young Bucks. The bout will be contested under a chaotic stipulation featuring chairs, tables, and ladders.
Copeland and Cage successfully retained the championships against Matt and Nick Jackson at AEW All In 2026, but Copeland admitted that he wasn’t satisfied with the way they secured the victory. After reviewing the match footage, Copeland discovered that Christian had used a wrench during the bout — something that he hadn’t realized at the time.
FTR, consisting of Dax Harwood and Cash Wheeler, will now get another opportunity to capture the titles. Their most recent match came at AEW Double or Nothing, where they were defeated by Copeland and Cage in an “I Quit” match.
